title: The Umbra Database System
by: Thomas Neumann’s group, Technical University of Munich
summary: The research site for Umbra, the successor to HyPer and the basis of CedarDB: a feature overview and the full publication list with PDFs, from the CIDR 2020 paper “Umbra: A Disk-Based System with In-Memory Performance” onwards. You can try queries in the browser or pull a Docker image, but its terms allow only evaluation, not production use.
